scrolling.history_description: History lines retained per terminal. Applies to new terminals only.

notifications.duration_description: Choose when in-app notifications close, or keep them until dismissed.
notifications.duration_details: Applies to new or refreshed in-app cards. Defaults: short toasts 5 seconds, banners 90 seconds, update notices until dismissed. Only the latest three cards are kept, including in persistent mode. Closing or replacing a card never answers a confirmation or changes task state. System notifications are unchanged.
notifications.ai_messages_description: Show AI toasts in the lower-right corner. System notifications are unaffected.
notifications.ai_messages_details: Turning this off dismisses existing in-app AI toasts and hides new completion and confirmation toasts. System notifications, including Windows notifications, and tab status indicators are unchanged. Terminal output and confirmation requests in the terminal remain available.

appearance.background_color_description: Overrides the terminal background supplied by the theme. This also changes the color reported to applications by OSC 11, which TUIs use to choose light or dark mode.
appearance.background_cover_title: Extend the background image beneath window controls?
appearance.background_cover_description: The image will extend beneath the title bar, window buttons, tabs, and SSH sidebar. Low-contrast images may make controls harder to see; the interface retains a minimum-opacity safeguard.

font.ligatures_description: Combine characters such as -> and != when supported by the font. Applies immediately to open terminals.
font.ui_family_description: Enter an installed font family; leave empty for the default. Applies on Enter or leaving the field.
font.ui_size_description: Changes interface text and component sizing independently of terminal text.
font.chinese_description: Used for Chinese and other full-width characters. Enter a font family or comma-separated families; leave empty to use Maple Mono NF CN. Applies on Enter or leaving the field.
font.fallback_description: The first family is preferred; missing glyphs fall back through the remaining families, with bundled Maple as the final safe fallback.
font.group_description: The first family is primary; the rest are used in fallback order.

keymap.help: Click a shortcut and press a new combination. Backspace clears it; Esc cancels. Use the row buttons to clear or restore defaults.

ssh.default_keys: If unspecified, IdentityFile and the default id_* private keys are used.
ssh.address_hint: Supports user@host; you can also paste ssh://host:2222
ssh.auth_auto_description: Tries available private keys first, then asks for a password. This is the best choice in most cases.
ssh.auth_interactive_description: Stores no credentials and prompts in the terminal when connecting, including two-factor authentication.
ssh.empty_hint: Use "+ Add host" or maintain aliases in ~/.ssh/config
ssh.shared_data_hint: Uses the same data as the legacy shell. Deleting a config alias hides it and it can be restored.

quick_terminal.description: The dedicated window remembers its size. Showing an existing window does not create a tab.

mouse.focus_follows_mouse_description: Focus a terminal pane when the pointer moves over it. Off by default.

panes.dim_inactive_description: Darken other split panes to make the active pane easier to identify.

settings.reset_description: This will reset your settings and keyboard shortcuts. SSH hosts, credentials and history will be kept, and your current settings will be backed up. Continue?

startup.launch_at_login_help: Start Pebrel when you sign in to Windows. Uses the same startup shortcut as the installer.
startup.silent_start_help: Start in the background without showing a window. Enables the system tray; click its icon to reopen. Applies while the tray is enabled, except when opening a directory explicitly.
